description: Architecture Decision Record: a short, numbered document describing one significant decision, its context and its consequences.
Title, Status, Context, Decision, Consequences. Proposed by Michael Nygard in 2011.
Replace an accepted decision with a new ADR. The old record keeps its text and only changes status to "Superseded by ADR N".
A decision that affects structure, quality attributes, dependencies or interfaces and would need a migration to reverse.
